_comment: Course identity for the UIC CS notebook theme (uicTheme.css). Values only - the stylesheet itself names no course. To reuse this notebook toolkit for another class, change these five fields and nothing else. Any field can also be overridden per-session with an environment variable: UIC_COURSE_CODE, UIC_COURSE_TITLE, UIC_SEMESTER, UIC_INSTITUTION, UIC_UNIT.
